bundle.shortDescription: Install, update and build Leonida from your own game copy
bundle.longDescription: Leonida Launcher installs the Leonida static recompilation project, keeps it in sync with the official upstream repository, verifies compatibility before every update, checks the Windows toolchain and drives the project's own build pipeline. It never downloads game files and never works around copy protection.
